documents.title: Return Policy
documents.content: We accept returns within 30 days of purchase with original receipt. Refunds are processed within 5-7 business days to the original payment method. Items must be unused and in original packaging.

documents.title: Shipping Policy
documents.content: Free standard shipping on orders over $50. Standard delivery takes 3-5 business days. Express shipping available for $15 with 1-2 day delivery.

documents.title: Warranty Policy
documents.content: All products include a 12-month manufacturer warranty covering defects in materials and workmanship. Warranty does not cover accidental damage, misuse, or normal wear and tear.

documents.title: Remote Work Policy
documents.content: Employees may work remotely up to 3 days per week with manager approval. Core hours are 10am-3pm in employee's local timezone. VPN connection required for accessing company systems.

documents.title: Data Security Policy
documents.content: All customer data must be encrypted at rest and in transit. Access to production databases requires MFA and is logged. PII must never be stored in development environments.
